==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Rosselini:''' Thief! Pickpocket! You should be ashamed of what you did!
:'''Rosselini:''' Ah, an Acolyte from the Order Penitentiary! You are just in time—take this urchin and throw her onto the Pilgrim's Sail! She tried to steal my pocket watch!
:'''Dindo:''' Sir, please, calm down. The Pilgrim's Sail is for people of false faith to seek repentance.
:'''Dindo:''' This child is no heretic, so she can't be banished.
:'''Rosselini:''' Is the Order covering for criminals now?!
:'''Dindo:''' No, you misunderstood. Theft falls under the jurisdiction of the Chamber of Discipline, but since she is a minor, I believe it would be more appropriate for the Chamber of Enlightenment to handle her case.
:'''Dindo:''' Child, tell me why you stole. Do you need help?
:'''Pepe:''' No! I want to go on the Pilgrim's Sail! I'm a heretic! I'm a bad kid who stole for no good reason! Mr. Acolyte, please arrest me!
:'''Dindo:''' But child... do you really understand what it means to be a heretic?
:'''Pepe:''' I...
:'''Dindo:''' See? I know you are not one.
:'''Pepe:''' Wait! I have to board the Pilgrim's Sail to find my brother! He was banished!
:'''Dindo:''' Banished? You've misunderstood the purpose of the Pilgrim's Sail... Listen, you will be rewarded for your patience.
:'''Dindo:''' Just stay home and wait, and stop making poor choices. If you behave... he may return safely from his pilgrimage.
{{Dialogue End}}
